title: Mutton curry with bone recipe: Telangana village Sunday mutton, Hyderabad, never frozen

story_clips.heygen_prompt: Photorealistic documentary-style vertical shot, shot on a 35 mm lens, Sunday late morning in a rural Telangana village courtyard: extreme close-up of a large black clay pot of thick red goat mutton curry simmering on a wood-fire chulha, an Indian woman's hand in a cotton saree sleeve lifts a steel ladle holding a tender bone-in mutton piece, steam rising, curry dripping back into the pot, then the camera pulls back to show the big pot and the whitewashed mud wall. Hands only, no face. Warm natural daylight, slight handheld camera, shallow depth of field. No text, no logos, no plastic-looking skin, no extra fingers.

Photorealistic documentary-style vertical shot, shot on a 35 mm lens, Sunday lunchtime in a rural Telangana village courtyard with a tiled roof: an Indian grandmother in a faded cotton saree serves mutton curry with bone pieces from a clay pot onto banana leaves with steaming white rice for a family of three generations sitting in a row on a palm mat; close-up of curry poured over rice.
